records.reason_code: Terra/LUNA/UST crisis overshadows recovery signals, with persistent liquidity risks and exchange delistings dominating sentiment. Institutional caution (e.g., Galaxy Digital losses, GBTC discount) contrasts with minor altcoin rallies (ADA, gaming tokens) and institutional ETF inflows, but Terra’s unresolved instability and contagion fears weigh heavily.
Ethereum-Solana rivalry and Solana momentum outweighs minor regulatory noise; Bitcoin funding recovery provides cautious optimism.
